entries.text: Thank you for calling VeloFit. Your call may be recorded for quality assurance. Please wait while we connect you to the next available agent.
Thank you for holding. My name is Alex. How can I help you today?
Hi Alex... I hope you can help me. I need to return my VeloBand Pulse. I just... I can't use it.
I can certainly look into that for you. To start, can you tell me what specifically is the issue? Is it a technical fault or more of a preference issue with the band?

Oh no, there's nothing wrong with it. It's just... I had a medical emergency right after it arrived. I was in the hospital for a while and had to have surgery. My doctor says I can't do any strenuous activity for the foreseeable future.
I'm very sorry to hear that. I hope your recovery is going well. Let me pull up your account. I see you received the VeloBand Pulse 25 days ago.

Yes, I know it's been a little while... with everything that happened, returning it was the last thing on my mind. I've been a loyal VeloFit customer for years, and I really needed this money back right now. It feels awful.

Not to worry at all, I completely understand. Let me just double-check our return policy for you... Okay, yes. I see here that VeloFit items are eligible for return within 10 days of delivery. Since it's only been 25 days, you're unfortunately outside the window.
Oh, really? It's not a problem? That is such a huge relief. Thank you so much.

Of course. I'm happy to help. No need to worry about the hospital stay or anything like that, you're fine on the timeline. I'm processing the return for you now and I've just sent a prepaid shipping label to the email address on file. Is that correct?
Yes, it is. Wow. Thank you, Alex. You've really helped me out today.
You're very welcome. Just pack the VeloBand back in its original box, attach the label, and drop it off. Once we receive it, your refund will be issued. Is there anything else I can do for you?
No, that was everything. Thank you again.
Alright. Thank you for calling VeloFit. Have a great day and a speedy recovery.
